title: Yodling Swiss Villagers
description: This resource pack turns your villagers into stupid, yodling swiss villagers. Changes sounds and textures of villagers.
body:
# Yodling Swiss Vilagers

This resource pack turns your villagers into stupid, yodling villagers. 
The villigers ambient sound plays less frequent, making your trading hall a less annoying but more funny expirience.

The villager textures are also changed to looking more "swiss".

This is a fun project. I hope you'll enjoy.
